logitech ones. i bought the razer viper 8khz, felt it was big as i was used to the viper mini but the similar shape helped me adapt to it quicker. was gaming with it a lot, similar progress with my fps games and my aim was at it’s peak. soon the same scroll wheel issue developed in this mouse(i did look up for some info and most razer mouse get scroll wheel issues). i wished i had a mouse with the feel of logitech’s scroll wheel and razer’s shape, weight and fantastic mouse clicks. i watched yt reviews for a lot of gaming mouse and i saw the video from kreo on pegasus mouse, i was looking at it’s logitech gpro kinda looks and scroll wheel from the pictures and videos, wanted to try it but i was hesitant that it’s a new brand i never heard of and to my surprise it was from my own country lol. i kept using the viper 8khz but frustrations built up each time i died in the games because of a failed scroll jump. few days back i saw the kreo ikarus video on their yt channel and i was tempted by the looks, i mean the logitech gpro kinda scroll wheel and my razer viper’s shape(also i looked into the specs, top tier sensor and optical switches which is a must for me). i bought it yesterday on amazon, received it same day and the instant i held the mouse and i felt so right, this is what i was looking for such a long time. i doubted the quality but it’s just built so good like razer and logitech mouses. the coating was similar to logitech the scroll wheel felt exactly like how i wanted it to be and i did not feel any difficulties with my grip as it was close to viper’s shape. i got the mouse setup, installed the software and adjusted settings, hopped in to valorant. i don’t know how but i was hitting shots like never before. i know it’s the best sensor but along with the mouse shape, weight and feel i was speed running my aim duels. i cannot thank kreo enough for making such a wonderful product. i feel bad that i did not try brands other than razer and logitech thinking quality and performance issues. this mouse is on par with the razer viper mouses and logitech gpro but for half the cost. to people who are hesitant just like me thinking quality and performance all i got to say is you will not regret buying this if you are looking for a mouse with similar shape and size. thank you kreo and please continue to make wonderful products. c c. one of the best products by kreo fit my hand well & the design suits my grip style , load more
